contract: POST /init. Create one root account only on an uninitialized installation, retaining credential/default/settings persistence and first-login payload; repeat initialization must deny and preserve the existing account.
exceptions: No separate force/refresh mode is defined for this endpoint; any repeat, changed-input or lifecycle refresh remains unverified in the state scenarios.

Mapping only: no tests executed in this invocation. Historical evidence is retained for provenance and does not verify this checkout; named tests are assertion leads, not exhaustive proof of every stated requirement.
force is not applicable: this requirement has no force, hard or override mode

invariants.contract: POST /init on an uninitialised installation answers 200 and persists exactly one active root user (given or default "root" username as written, bcrypt hash or empty hash, JWT token, full root permissions); /status then reports isInit true without paths and login works. Any further POST /init, or one on an initialised server, answers 500 and changes no user.
